scripts.!start: ------ run in local development (note! ts-node seems not watch '.js' file) ----
scripts.*start: nodemon --watch src --exec ts-node --compiler typescript -r tsconfig-paths/register src/index.ts
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "TypeScript,Node" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run watch-ts" "npm run nodemon"
scripts.!express: ---- run express server in local (LOCAL_MODE=1: lemon-core local mode; express: SNS/SQS/protocol sends to this service are delivered in-process, express.aws: real AWS) -----
scripts.express: ENV=none STAGE=local LOCAL_MODE=1 LOCAL_TRANSPORT=mock npm run start
scripts.express.aws: ENV=none STAGE=local LOCAL_MODE=1 npm run start
scripts.deploy: npm run build && sls deploy --param='profile=none' --stage dev
scripts.deploy.prod: npm run build && sls deploy --param='profile=none' --stage prod
scripts.!ssocio: ----- deploy to `ssocio` account (aws-profile is explicit to avoid mis-targeting) -----
scripts.deploy.ssocio: npm run build && sls deploy --param='profile=ssocio' --stage prod --aws-profile ssocio
scripts.pack.ssocio: npm run build && sls package --param='profile=ssocio' --stage prod
scripts.!muzly: ----- deploy to `muzly` account (aws-profile is explicit to avoid mis-targeting) -----
scripts.deploy.muzly: npm run build && sls deploy --param='profile=muzly' --stage dev --aws-profile muzly
scripts.deploy.muzly.prod: npm run build && sls deploy --param='profile=muzly' --stage prod --aws-profile muzly
scripts.pack.muzly: npm run build && sls package --param='profile=muzly' --stage dev
scripts.!epyt: ----- deploy to `epyt` account (aws-profile is explicit to avoid mis-targeting) -----
scripts.deploy.epyt: npm run build && sls deploy --param='profile=epyt' --stage dev --aws-profile epyt
scripts.deploy.epyt.prod: npm run build && sls deploy --param='profile=epyt' --stage prod --aws-profile epyt
scripts.pack.epyt: npm run build && sls package --param='profile=epyt' --stage prod
scripts.!pack: ------- build gulp and prepare to release -----
scripts.pack: npm run build && sls package --param='profile=none' --stage dev
scripts.pack.prod: npm run build && sls package --param='profile=none' --stage prod
scripts.!logs: ------- print logs of serverless by profile -----
scripts.!lambda: ------- invoke the deployed lambda / watch its logs (bin/) -----
